title: First Day at School
description: NCERT Class 2 English (Marigold), Unit 1 poem. The levels move from the chapter's new words, to understanding the poem, to its grammar focus (naming words), to writing a sentence of your own.

nodes.title: New Words
nodes.skill: Read and use the chapter's new words: school, friend, teacher, new, happy.
nodes.teach_focus: Meaning of each new word from the poem; use a new word in a short, correct phrase.
nodes.success_criteria: Uses two or more of the chapter's new words correctly.
nodes.bridge_focus: Name just one new word from the poem and what it means.

bridge_exercises.sentence: On the first day, I made a new ___ at school.
bridge_exercises.hint: a person you play and learn with
bridge_exercises.context: Uses a chapter word in the poem's own situation.

bridge_exercises.hint: the person who helps you learn
bridge_exercises.context: Checks the meaning of a key chapter word.

exemplars: A school is a place where we learn.
My teacher is kind and helps me.

nodes.title: Read and Understand
nodes.skill: Understand the poem: a child's feelings on the first day of school.
nodes.teach_focus: The main idea and feelings in the poem (new, a little scared, then happy); answer a simple who/what/how question.
nodes.success_criteria: Answers a simple question about the poem in one clear sentence.
nodes.bridge_focus: Say how the child feels on the first day in one word.

bridge_exercises.sentence: How does the child feel at the END of the first day?
On the first day, school is a ___ place for the child.
bridge_exercises.hint: not old; you have not seen it before
bridge_exercises.context: Checks understanding of the first-day feeling.

exemplars: The child feels happy because they make new friends.
The first day is new, but it becomes fun.

nodes.title: Naming Words (Nouns)
nodes.skill: Find and use naming words (nouns) for people and things in school.
nodes.teach_focus: A naming word names a person, place, animal, or thing (teacher, bag, book, class).
nodes.success_criteria: Picks or writes a correct naming word for a person or thing in school.
nodes.bridge_focus: Name one thing you carry to school.

bridge_exercises.sentence: Which one is a naming word (a thing in school)?
bridge_exercises.context: Sorts a noun from a verb and an adjective.

bridge_exercises.sentence: I keep my books in my ___.
bridge_exercises.hint: a thing you carry to school
bridge_exercises.context: Produces a naming word in a real school sentence.

exemplars: Naming words in my class: teacher, desk, board.
A pencil and a book are naming words.

nodes.title: Use It: Write a Sentence
nodes.skill: Write one simple sentence about your first day or your school.
nodes.teach_focus: A sentence has who + what, a capital letter at the start, and a full stop at the end.
nodes.success_criteria: One complete sentence about school, with a capital letter and a full stop.

bridge_exercises.sentence: On my first day, I met my new ___.
bridge_exercises.context: Scaffolds the writing task with a frame to complete.

bridge_exercises.hint: a place in school: playground, library, garden
bridge_exercises.context: A second frame so the learner produces their own detail.

exemplars: On my first day, I felt happy and made a friend.
My school is big and I like my class.

chapter_test.title: First Day at School: Chapter Test

items.prompt: How does the child feel at the end of the first day?
Which word is a naming word?
I carry my books in my ___.
On my first day, I made a new ___.
